We took our puppy here for her first grooming last week because the salon advertises itself as a clean, spa-like place. The facility was clean, and the employees were friendly.

When we dropped her off, they only asked how short we wanted her body cut. They never discussed her facial hair or asked how we wanted her face to look. They cut so much off her face without asking that she looks like a completely different dog. Before the appointment, she had an adorable teddy bear look. Now that look is gone, and we’re very disappointed with the result.

It also seems like her coat was lightened or bleached. Her color looks different, and she even smells different than before.

I called to speak with the manager about our concerns. I was disappointed that there was no apology. She said she would talk to the groomer, but instead she simply handed the phone to the groomer. The groomer also never apologized. She asked, “What can we do to fix it?” Since this is our first puppy and her very first haircut, I honestly didn’t know how to respond. Once the hair is cut, there’s really no way to undo it.

Unfortunately, because of both the grooming result and how our concerns were handled, we will not be returning.

I’ve been debating posting this review for two weeks. Every year I get my standard poodle’s hair dyed for Astros Dog Day. This year, her usual colorist was unavailable, so we tried Pet Styling by Sherry. Since we were entering the costume contest, we planned to dye her green like Orbit, with orange on the tips, while the rest of us wore Orbit jerseys as her Astros handlers. The groomer even drew the plan out on a form, and I signed off on it.

She explained that because my poodle had already been groomed earlier in the week, she wouldn’t need another bath, so the process shouldn’t take long. They said they would call when she was ready. Since the salon was closing early at 4:00 p.m., I assumed I’d hear from them beforehand, but when I hadn’t received any updates, I went to the shop around 3:45.

When I arrived, the front desk staff recognized me and went to get the groomer. She came out immediately apologizing. She explained they had run out of green dye and had to run to the store for more. Unfortunately, the replacement dye didn’t match—it came out a very blue-teal. She said she tried to blend it in to make it cohesive, but it didn’t work. At first I thought maybe it could pass since the Astros’ colors include blue and orange, but when she brought my dog out, I saw how patchy, uneven, and teal it really was—and it was everywhere. There was dye on her muzzle, feet, and even spots where it looked like they clipped hair off her topknot to remove stray color.

I tried to remind myself it’s “just hair” and it will grow out, but it was still upsetting—especially at $80 (after a discount). What bothered me most was that they never once called to explain what was happening or ask if I wanted to continue when they realized the dye wouldn’t match. Instead, they pushed forward with something completely different from what I signed off on.

To add to my frustration, the groomer then asked to take a photo of the result. She apologized again and said she had been excited about the original plan, but I couldn’t understand why she’d want to photograph a botched job.

On the way home, I called the salon to confirm they would at least give me a complimentary groom to shave off the unwanted color once her hair grows out, and they did agree to add that to my profile. Now I’m just waiting until her coat is long enough to fix.

We had been taking mini to this place since she was 4 mths old.. she is a shih poo. My husband was always the one to drop her off due to my work schedule… mini has a lot of hair but I would always make sure that she was combed and brushed out prior to my husband taking her in and we had been getting her cut down shorter.Natalie would always give compliments and thank my husband for having her brushed out and not coming in with mats... the cuts were not always precise and we did not complain even though they went up on their prices and began to charge for bows….well on the one day that I bring her in for her cut the very thin lady behind the desk grabs mini (she is only 5lbs) and starts feeling all over her and shouts “ she’s matted” all for the world to hear and very unprofessional… I said no I bushed and combed her last night and this morning.. she then finds the tangle and said see she’s matted.. after going round for round with her and dealing with her aggressive behavior I told her I did not want to talk to her anymore because she was being too loud and aggressive, I asked her to get the groomer Natalie to come out.. Natalie and another lady comes out and began feeling on mini and we’re like oh yeah she is matted Natalie says oh well I will see what I can do with her… and the other lady that came out with the hair dryer and a comb saying yeah you may want to get this metal comb and I told her that I already have that comb and three other coms and brushes.. I ended up taking mini home because they were trying to charge a mat fee and was going to scalp my dog.. mini and were treated like I brought in a mange ridden dog.. very unprofessional they told me to bring her back in the next day … and I called them to tell them we won’t be coming back and I asked if they could have the owner sherry call me back and I never got a call… this is an unprofessional lack luster establishment… my husband was dumbfounded  and pissed as to the way we were treated and it was his decision to discontinue services with them.. seems if a man comes in they are all at attention! I can’t say enough good things about Pet Styling by Sherry. We have been using them for over 10 years.  They consistently do an excellent job grooming our dog Beau, and their genuine care and attention to detail are truly remarkable. Despite living 30 minutes away, we happily make the drive because of the quality of service is unmatched. Our dog always looks fantastic and is comfortable when he is there. We highly recommend Pet Styling by Sherry for anyone seeking top-notch grooming services!

Let me tell you I will make the drive to the best little dog house every time rather than coming back here. Biscuit is one the sweetest dogs and she has always been great with groomers so to see my dog bleeding after a grooming session is unbelievable.  The cut is massive and they didn't even cover it with anything or disinfected the wound. Check  ALL reviews because apparently this is common for this place. Go to Yelp and read their 1 star reviews and avoid taking your pets here.
